RULES made by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka under Section 18 of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Law,No. 4 of 1978 and approved by the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade.
Chairman, Board of Investment of Sri Lanka.Board of Investment of Sri Lanka,Colombo,01st January 2019.
